concerns.text: Success Criterion SC-001 (percentage of successfully processed subjects) is defined in spec.md but no task computes, records, or reports this metric. The pipeline should include a task that calculates and outputs the proportion of subjects with complete waking and sleep data.

Success Criterion SC-002 (runtime < 4 h) is only asserted via an integration test limit; there is no task that measures, logs, and stores the actual runtime of the full pipeline execution for later verification.

Success Criterion SC-003 (memory footprint < 4 GB) is similarly only checked in a test assertion. A dedicated task should capture and record peak RAM usage during pipeline execution to satisfy the success criterion.
